messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] library(Rhipe) does not run
parts:
Hi,

Permissions. Need some output, how does it fail?
Unfortunately, R doesn't allow the user to pass optons to the library command
a work around would have been to do nothing in the the on.load and ask the user
to initialize with rh.init. That provides more control on the output messages.

I might just do that.

Regards
S
